hint: the lease bucket and the rent and revenue-sharing bucket overlap: both cover what the airport charges
fix: puts what the airport charges (lease, rent and revenue share) in one bucket, so bucket 1 keeps only staff and supplies

hint: the coffee kiosk bucket doesn't belong: a planned kiosk can't explain why profit fell
fix: removes the kiosk bucket, or replaces it with something that could explain last year's drop

hint: it misses late materials from suppliers, before production starts
fix: adds a bucket or sub-points on suppliers: late or short deliveries of wood, fabric or parts

hint: the labor and staffing buckets overlap: staffing levels drive labor cost
fix: folds crew schedules and staffing levels into the labor bucket, as drivers of labor cost

hint: it misses how many riders would stop riding at the higher fare
fix: adds a bucket or sub-points on how many riders would drop at a 20% higher fare

hint: the ingredient-cost bucket doesn't belong: cheaper ingredients don't grow revenue
fix: removes the ingredient-cost bucket, or replaces it with a revenue lever such as price

hint: it's a generic profit tree: it can't judge a whole industry's outlook
fix: replaces the profit tree with buckets about the industry, such as demand growth, new supply, competition and returns per facility

hint: the brand-awareness bucket doesn't belong: national awareness can't decide one route
fix: removes the brand-awareness bucket, or narrows it to awareness in the two cities

hint: it misses competition: other airlines on the route, and driving or rail instead
fix: adds a bucket or sub-points on competition from other airlines on the route, or from driving or rail

hint: the net revenue retention bucket repeats the expansion and churn buckets: net retention nets expansion against churn
fix: removes the net retention bucket, or keeps it as the summary with expansion and churn under it

hint: it misses the cost of stations and of moving bikes between them
fix: adds a bucket or sub-points on station costs and on moving bikes between stations
